newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot power prices stablize after Tues. rise.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot power prices stablize after Tues. rise.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) stablized Wednesday after Tuesday's sharp rise on cold weather and softer natural gas prices.
"The screen's down. You're not going to see prices move as high as they are," said a Houston marketer, referring to lower natural gas futures today.
On the New York Mercantile Exchange, January Henry Hub gas futures fell as much as 27 cents per million British thermal units. The contract was last at $4.070, down 10 cents.
Swing gas prices in south Texas finished flat from Tuesday's levels, quoted near $4.50/mmBtu after trading as high as $5.00.
Texas temperatures did not dip as low as previously predicted, market sources noted.
"The weather didn't get as cold as anticipated," another Houston marketer.
Thursday's temperatures across most of Texas were predicted to run 15-20 Fahrenheit degrees below normal, plummeting to lows in the single digits and the teens, and climbing to highs in the 30s-45s.
Extended outlook showed ERCOT temperatures would begin to moderate Friday through the weekend.
Spot ERCOT power values remained very high with some Texas utilities switching on expensive generation that uses diesel fuel to meet peak demand periods, market sources said.
ERCOT firm, peak power for a 16-hour block for Thursday delivery were assessed at $57.00-$65.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), a much tighter range than Tuesday's $45.00-$70.00.
Non-firm peak power for Thursday was notationally pegged at $50.00-$60.00 versus a range of $42.00-$60.00 Tuesday.
Firm off-peak ERCOT deliveries for Thursday were talked in the $29.00-$31.00 range, compared with $30.00-$40.00 Tuesday.
Non-firm off-peak ERCOT power for Thursday was notationally assessed at $20.00-$30.00, lower than Tuesday's range of $25.00-$35.00.
ERCOT power for the rest of December was bid in the $45.00-$46.00 area, compared with Tuesday's $44.00-$50.00.
ERCOT January/February peak prices softened with lower gas futures prices, slipping to $36.00-$39.00, down from Tuesday's $41.00-$43.00.
